question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**Stagered**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the given word.
 
 
• Staggered: walk or move unsteadily, as if about to fall.

 
 
• ​**Example**: *After a heavy night of drinking, he **staggered **__up the stairs to his house.*
 
 
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is** option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **​Stooped: **(of a person) having the head and shoulders habitually bent forwards.
 
• **Stressed: **experiencing mental or emotional strain or tension.
 
• **Strived: **make great efforts to achieve or obtain something.
 
 
 
• ​All the other words are spelled correctly.
